source: Minecraft adapter development and NoteRail Testing acceptance

cases.title: Zero-byte .mca placeholders are not non-empty region corruption
cases.historical_symptom: The first one-off Minecraft validator classified every 0-byte region placeholder as a corrupt region, producing hundreds of false BREAKs.
cases.current_expectation: 0-byte .mca files are counted separately as placeholders/WEIRD; only malformed non-empty region files can produce region BREAK.

cases.title: Exact duplicate enabled datapacks are identity WEIRD, not cross-pack corruption
cases.historical_symptom: Two byte-identical enabled datapacks can collide on every function path while still containing identical content.
cases.current_expectation: Exact duplicate enabled groups are detected and reported WEIRD; their collisions are excluded from non-identical collision pairs.

cases.title: Unsafe datapack ZIP paths are security failures
cases.historical_symptom: A ZIP member using parent traversal or an absolute path could escape naïve extraction logic.
cases.current_expectation: Minecraft expert security/safety reports unsafe ZIP member paths as BREAK.

cases.title: Malformed non-empty region files must remain BREAK
cases.historical_symptom: Separating zero-byte placeholders from corruption must not make the region validator too permissive.
cases.current_expectation: A malformed non-empty .mca remains a high-severity region BREAK.
